Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the Super Over to get underway! Mukesh Kumar looks raring to bowl it and the Indian players are seen having a tense discussion. The umpires get in position as the pair of Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Gulbadin Naib comes out to the middle.
... SUPER OVER ...

Wow, wow, and wow! Afghanistan have given it their all and Gulbadin Naib has taken his team to level terms chasing down a score of 213 and they have finished on 212, the same as India, unbelievable. It was a topsy-turvy run chase but India looked in control at the halfway mark. The Afghans launched a sensational counter-attack, hitting 127 runs in the final 10 overs to get themselves a chance in the Super Over. It is anyone's game from here, so, fasten your seat belts and get ready as Afghanistan will now bat first in the Super Over.

The match is Tied and it will be a Super Over to follow now! Low full toss outside off, Gulbadin Naib carves it well to the deep cover region where Rinku Singh sprints and picks up. He misses out on a perfect throw to the keeper's end and Gulbadin Naib throttles for the second and is already home safely. What a run-chase we have witnessed here at Chinnaswamy! The crowd is roaring at its pinnacle but what an effort by Gulbadin Naib at the backend.

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks break! The Afghan openers have done quite a stellar job to be 85/0 at the halfway mark but they still need to take things up a few notches to have a real shout at chasing down this target. India have done well with the ball thus far and the spinners are proving to be fairly economical but they need wickets and can't just let Afghanistan keep on piling the runs. 128 needed off 60 balls now, can Afghanistan pull off a miracle? Let's find out.
